Do not assume a four-letter suffix or merge it with similarly named variants. EA211 and EA888 are family labels, not substitutes for the recorded code. Confirm ECU, transmission, emissions equipment and the supplied components against the donor VIN.
engines.sourcing_note: Search Chinese donor stock using BPL and the donor model together. The Chinese joint-venture and imported catalogue records above are separate sourcing leads. A shared code or filter application does not establish assembly interchangeability. Request current photos and an itemized offer for the exact unit.
